basic_profile.bio: Hey, I'm a 16-year-old high school student living in Long Island. I love sports, especially football and F1 racing, and I spend my free time writing lyrics and exploring philosophical questions. Not really a morning person, so I'm usually online in the evenings after school. I'm single and enjoy connecting with people who have similar interests. I tend to browse subreddits related to my interests, and I'm slowly discovering new communities here.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Currently in high school, I gain most of my knowledge from classes, online articles, and sometimes YouTube. I have a growing interest in philosophy, which I explore through reading and participating in discussions.
